host: Linux aarch64 (kernel 7.2.7-200.fc44.aarch64) container, 4 CPUs, 15 GiB; reference-host-like (same class as docs/performance/performance_report1.md)
profile: release (opt-level 3, lto = true, codegen-units = 1, panic = abort)

solver_rev.baseline: git HEAD 1208411: state/baseline.json was measured with the repo binary before the change landed (pristine HEAD source); state/ab_wall.json used a separate build of the same commit, `git archive HEAD | tar -x -C /tmp/plan1_base && cargo build --release --bins`
solver_rev.after: plan1 working tree: src/search/dfpn/cheap_probe.rs + run.rs gate wiring + preflight report/docs

cli_config.probe_stand_in: --tt-size 4 --budget 2000 --no-preflight --first-outcome --outcome-only (Phase 0 calibration stand-in for the scratch probe)

drivers.driver.py: per-corpus-case CLI runs (wall median, peak RSS via os.wait4, parsed stdout/stderr); modes probe|baseline|after
drivers.ab_wall.py: interleaved baseline/after wall-clock A/B (15 repetitions, one run of each arm per repetition) on the production config
drivers.compare.py: renders the report tables from state/{baseline,after,ab_wall}.json

notes: Wall-clock medians are container wall time and drift by a few percent between measurement windows; the interleaved A/B (state/ab_wall.json) is the authoritative wall comparison, the sequential baseline/after files are for evals/RSS/status.
Peak RSS is ru_maxrss of the child process (includes the 256 MB TT label and, on the baseline arm, the transient closure allocation).
No raw solver transcripts are committed (AGENTS.md measurement layout); the drivers plus the parsed JSON are the record.
